# Local dependencies

`elk.bundled.js` is the unmodified ELK.js 0.12.0 browser bundle, reused from the local Garage viewer. Its source is the official package https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz.

SHA-256: `1222e44f953ce7746af23801e723708f8e6f436b8b377a6a5fc7552f34a307b3`.

License: EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later. See `ELK-LICENSE.md`. Project: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs.

The viewer loads the local bundle. It does not download libraries or send diagrams to a service.
